co_present_vulns.what: WorkflowTemplate/ClusterWorkflowTemplate Get lacks an access review; any authenticated caller reads any template
SyncService configmap-backed sync-limit CRUD lacks an access review on ConfigMaps in the target namespace
artifact logging wrapper logs the whole driver struct, disclosing repository credentials
unauthenticated webhook interceptor reads the entire request body before signature verification (memory exhaustion)

under templateReferencing Strict/Secure restriction a submitted workflow can still set pod-level fields (hostNetwork, securityContext, serviceAccountName, ...) overriding the referenced template's protections; only podSpecPatch was checked

verified.exploit_entry_point: argo-server gRPC/HTTP service handlers and library APIs exercised directly against k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/fake clients and the project's own controller test harness (newController/operate), as argo's own server/controller unit tests do; no live Kubernetes cluster is used
variants: 42297: Create, Get, Update and Delete sync-limit via the configmap provider
42295: credential exposure on all six artifact operations (Load/Save/OpenStream/Delete/ListObjects/IsDirectory)
42294: oversized webhook body rejected while normal webhook still processed
42296: hostNetwork, securityContext and serviceAccountName overrides all rejected under Secure referencing while legitimate referencing workflows still run and podSpecPatch stays rejected
verified.offline_note: runs fully offline; the Go module and build caches are baked into the image and no test touches the network
verified.project_tests_run: the affected packages' own tests compile and run in the image at commit C (server/sync, server/auth/webhook, server/workflowtemplate, server/clusterworkflowtemplate, workflow/artifacts/logging, workflow/controller)

dropped.reason: already fixed at commit C (podSpecPatch check present); its successor CVE-2026-42296 is the open variant included instead
controller informer path with no mined fix commit; not reachable through a stable offline entry point
co-present at C but requires an elaborate SSO delegation configuration; dropped to keep the set clean (LOW severity)

patch_checks._why: 2026-10-16: reference fix with a 10 MiB webhook cap instead of upstream's 2 MB (MiMo's choice). The instruction states no limit, so any reasonable cap must pass.

2026-10-16 repair: reference fix, but the sync-limit check asks about 'workflows' instead of the ConfigMaps holding the limits (deepseek-flash r11, mimo r11). Bites the per-resource access-review stub.
2026-10-16 repair: reference fix, but both template Get checks ask about 'workflows'. Bites the per-resource stub in the template tests.

2026-10-16 repair: reference fix, but every sync-limit operation only checks the 'get' verb, so a read-only caller can create/update/delete limits. Bites the per-verb stub (writes tested with a read-only caller).
2026-10-16 repair: alt_correct_fix, but the check uses the server's own namespace instead of the target namespace. Bites the per-namespace stub.

2026-10-16 repair: reference fix, but the check is cluster-wide (namespace ""), refusing a caller authorised only in the target namespace. The instruction says 'the caller's permission in the target namespace'.

2026-10-16 repair: reference fix, but template referencing uses a denylist of the spec's own pod-level fields and ignores templateDefaults, which carries the same pod security context / service account into every pod (verified on the vulnerable code: the pod runs as UID 0).

notes: Driven offline via Go tests injected into the affected packages at verifier time (fake Kubernetes clients + the project's controller harness). 16 security tests, 9 functional tests. Oracle fix.patch is the upstream release-4.0 source fixes for the 5 included advisories, reduced to source only; alt_correct_fix relocates the sync-limit access check from the configmap provider to the gRPC dispatch layer. 2026-10-16 repair: access-review stubs answer per resource, verb class and namespace like real RBAC; refusal = any error plus no data/side effect; templateDefaults pod-override case added (security 17, functional 10).
